sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The June 30 announcement identifies the exact model and compares capability, cost and effort with Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8. It publishes no nominal total or active count and no size-bearing base relationship; a capability upgrade is not a weight-sharing statement.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact specifications identify claude-sonnet-5, June 30 release and 1M context, but contain no total/active parameter count. The former what-is-new URL redirects here; its indexed upgrade/new-tokenizer description also provides no size-bearing base.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected October 27 from the parent's same-day full official-PDF cache. Section 1 describes Sonnet 5 as an upgrade to 4.6; section 1.1 describes pretraining followed by post-training/fine-tuning, without naming a publicly sized base. Searched the complete text for parameter, activated, billion/trillion, base and structural-change terms. Parameter mentions are effort settings, not model size; no nominal total or active disclosure was found.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable. Used for the distribution policy, not to infer architecture.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Service terms grant permission to use Anthropic services and reserve intellectual-property rights except as expressly stated. Together with the explicit nonpublic-weight policy this supports descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: Current documentation says all active models support PDF processing. It describes extraction of document text and conversion of each page to an image; the exact Sonnet 5 page identifies it as Active (legacy).

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Official function-calling documentation names Claude Sonnet 5 in its tool-use token table, with auto/none and any/tool tool_choice settings. The original exact-model card also documents programmatic tool-calling evaluations.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Sonnet 5 summary
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact Sonnet 5 summary describes pretraining and substantial post-training, training data and software/hardware without a nominal total, active count or named sized base. Its comparisons concern behavior and capabilities.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27. Exact Sonnet 5 comparisons report capabilities and safety; parameter matches refer to effort settings. No total or activated-parameter column, or size-bearing target lineage, was found.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27. Sonnet 5 appears in capability and safeguards comparisons; no total/active count or sized-base relationship for Sonnet 5 is disclosed.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27. Exact Sonnet 5 comparisons report evaluation results; nearby parameter terminology concerns harness adjustments. No nominal total or activated-parameter column for Sonnet 5 was found.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27. Exact Sonnet 5 comparisons report safety and capability results; effort parameters are test-time controls. No target total/active count or size-bearing lineage is disclosed.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the freshly retrieved full official PDF text on October 27. Exact Sonnet 5 comparison rows report evaluation scores, and base-condition references describe experiments. No total/active parameter count or sized-base relationship for the target was found.

sources.title: Automated Researchers Can Mitigate Well-Characterized Alignment Failures
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026 as an exact-model training/lineage lead. Section 6 uses Sonnet 5 as an automated researcher to post-train an early Opus 4.8 checkpoint; it does not identify Sonnet 5 as derived from Opus 4.8. The numbers 156 and 158 are capability-index scores, not billions of parameters; the article supplies no target model size.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026 to resolve the approximately 584B Sonnet 5 lead. This independent research estimates coarse factual knowledge capacity; the exact model's actual-parameter columns are blank. Its prediction interval is not an Anthropic nominal count and it supplies no active parameter specification.

sources.title: Estimating the Parameter Counts of the Claude 5 and GPT-5.6 Families
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026 to resolve the 719B and approximately 970B Sonnet 5 estimates. The article explicitly defines these as IKP-effective knowledge capacity, not true weight counts, with wide prediction intervals and additional imputation uncertainty. It supplies neither developer nominal counts nor active parameters.

sources.title: Anthropic and xAI Model Parameter Counts
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026 solely to trace the generic 1T Sonnet lead. The April 9 article attributes the figure to Musk about unspecified then-current Sonnet, predating the June 30 Sonnet 5 launch. It provides no exact-model lineage, Anthropic confirmation or active count.

name.note: Exact official display name and API identifier.

developer.note: Section 1 identifies the model as developed by Anthropic.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the exact Sonnet-class designation.

release_date.note: Dated announcement says available from that day; current specifications agree. This is launch timing rather than a training snapshot date.

open_weights.note: Explicit nonpublic Claude-weight policy applies to the model; hosted access is separately confirmed.

license.note: Descriptive classification of a nonpublic-weight service offered under commercial terms, not the name of an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review of the launch, exact specifications/card, transparency entry, five later cards and exact-model research found no developer-published nominal total or explicit size-bearing base lineage. Generic pretraining/post-training and successor wording do not identify a publicly sized base. Resolved 584B/719B/about 970B leads as knowledge-capacity estimates and 1T as an unspecified older-Sonnet claim. Null reflects absent nominal evidence, not a demand for exact tensor counting.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-parameter searches and exact-model rows in five later first-party cards found no nominal active count or activated-parameter column for Sonnet 5. Effort and sampling parameters are inference controls; IKP estimates factual capacity rather than active computation. No total-to-active equality or topology is inferred.

architecture.note: No explicit production architecture found in inspected sources. Residual-stream probing in the exact card is insufficient to identify Transformer or dense/MoE structure. No architecture is transferred from other Claude models or earlier snapshots; interpretability-tool dimensions and normalized layers are not model dimensions.

modalities.note: Specifications state text/image input and text output. Sonnet 5 was directly evaluated with base64 PDF inputs; PDF is a document format processed as text and page images. App-level dictation/text-to-speech does not add native audio modalities.

reasoning.note: Dedicated adaptive thinking is documented and enabled by default; this is not inferred from chain-of-thought prompting.

tool_call.note: Exact Sonnet 5 appears in the official function-calling support table; the card reports programmatic tool calling.

patch.notes: Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; third-party knowledge-capacity estimates are not weight counts. Architecture remains undisclosed. summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh original-source, exact-model research and five later first-party comparison checks. Resolved 584B/719B/about 970B leads as behavioral capacity estimates and generic 1T as an older, unspecified Sonnet claim. No developer nominal count or supported size-bearing lineage was found. All unrelated field assessments are preserved.
